title: Young Child Playing in Snowy Yard of Suburban Home, 1955 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from 1955 depicting a young child warmly bundled in a winter coat and hat playing in a heavy snowfall outside a suburban home. Behind the child is a classic post-WWII American ranch-style house featuring brick construction, a prominent front picture window, snow-capped roof, and a rooftop television antenna, evoking classic mid-20th century domestic family life.
